latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor Free Mac — AI-powered video editing and export for Mac users.

- Instantly edit and export raw video clips up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) using cloud AI—no local installation needed.
- Simple natural-language prompts for editing (e.g., "trim the boring parts, add transitions, and export as MP4").
- Automatic onboarding: free anonymous authentication with 100 trial credits, valid for 7 days.
- Fast 1080p MP4 exports, typically ready to download in 1–2 minutes for short clips.
- Handles multiple formats and common workflows like batch processing and timeline refinement.
- Built for Mac creators seeking easy, fast edits without paid software.
